newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on Comcast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on Comcast.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it named Comcast Corp its Focus One stock of week, keeping its near- and long-term buy ratings on the shares.
-- Analyst Jessica Reif said Comcast's shares represented the best value in the undervalued cable group.
-- She said she expected the company to turn free cash-flow positive in 1998.
-- The company's balance sheet has strengthened "dramatically," she said.
-- Reif set a 12-to-18-month price target of $28 on the stock.
